question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the bracketed word in the following sentence to fill in the blank.

The setting sun turned the ________ (calm) ocean into a sea of gold.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"calm"** means free from excitement or passion; tranquil. (शांत)

 
 
• **Example: **He remained **calm** even during the crisis.
 
 
 
• **"Placid"** refers to something that is not easily upset or excited; calm and peaceful. (शांत)
 
 
• **Example: **The **placid** lake was a perfect place for meditation.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2.**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Volatile** (अस्थिर): Liable to change rapidly and unpredictably, especially for the worse.

 
 
• **Example:** The stock market is highly volatile.
 
 
 
• **Furtive** (गुप्त): Attempting to avoid notice or attention, typically because of guilt or a belief that discovery would lead to trouble.
 
 
• **Example:** She cast a furtive glance at the man.
 
 
 
• **Scattered** (बिखरा हुआ): Occurring or found at intervals or various locations rather than all together.
 
 
• **Example:** The books were scattered all over the floor.
